primaryQuery: can Tuya devices work locally with Home Assistant
readerQuestion: Can I control the Tuya or Smart Life devices I already own locally in Home Assistant, and which connection path should I use?
selectedBecause: Recent Reddit and Home Assistant Community discussions repeatedly ask whether adding Tuya to Home Assistant removes the cloud and which of several local methods is dependable. The exact-query results mix the current cloud-based core integration with older developer-project instructions and community local integrations, leaving a practical gap around onboarding, offline control, privacy, exact-device support, direct Zigbee, and Matter bridges. Search Console opportunities were reviewed first: its high-impression query families already have owner paths and must not become new URLs, while no Tuya query or owner path appears in the supplied export. The question is durable, fits Tara's local-control guidance, and is distinct from Tara's Govee compatibility, general no-cloud, and Tuya infrared pages.

searchReview.query: can Tuya devices work locally with Home Assistant
searchReview.intent: The reader wants to keep existing Tuya or Smart Life hardware, control it from Home Assistant with the least cloud dependence possible, and know which path will remain reliable for the exact device.
searchReview.resultGap: The current results split the answer across an official Cloud Push integration page, older developer-project setup instructions, and community integrations with similar names. They rarely give one homeowner decision table that separates official support, local traffic, required cloud onboarding, outbound cloud behavior, direct Zigbee, Matter bridging, battery-device limits, and exact-model caveats.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Tuya integration
officialSources.supports: The built-in integration uses Smart Life or Tuya Smart QR authorization, is classified Cloud Push, and can expose fewer features than the Tuya SDK provides.

officialSources.name: Tuya stable Home Assistant setup
officialSources.supports: The current official setup uses the mobile app user code and QR flow and does not guarantee support for every Tuya device category.

officialSources.name: Tuya Local project documentation
officialSources.supports: The community integration documents local Wi-Fi control, exact-model and firmware variation, single-connection limits, battery Wi-Fi limits, and the fact that local control does not block Tuya cloud traffic.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant ZHA documentation
officialSources.supports: ZHA can replace many proprietary Zigbee gateways, but Home Assistant does not promise an exact universal device compatibility list and non-standard devices may need quirks.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Matter documentation
officialSources.supports: Matter devices and bridges use a local control path, but commercial bridges can require accounts and may expose only a subset of their connected devices and features.

officialSources.name: Zigbee2MQTT MOES smart plug compatibility page
officialSources.supports: Zigbee2MQTT currently documents direct support and exposed controls for the named MOES smart plug with power monitoring.

officialSources.name: Zemismart M1 product page
officialSources.supports: The vendor identifies the M1 as a Tuya Zigbee Matter bridge with Smart Life setup and QR sharing to supported Matter ecosystems.

existingCoverage.decision: The proposed page owns a Tuya-specific compatibility decision: built-in cloud integration versus community local Wi-Fi control versus direct Zigbee versus a Matter bridge.
